title: Deterministic Entity, Input, Collision & State Kernel

selection_basis.strict_order: GPR-01 → GPR-03 → GPR-05 → GPR-06 → GPR-07 → GPR-08 → GPR-09 → GPR-10 → GPR-12 → GPR-16
selection_basis.parallel_lanes: MRCS-16 and OARC-03 remain independently selected_not_started.

objective: Implement the deterministic gameplay-instance entity/input/collision/state kernel over the GPR-01 registry seam: semantic input abstraction, collision/trigger handling, declared deterministic transition ordering, seed/configuration binding and bounded runtime/authoring caps without making presentation frame order authoritative.
acceptance: GameplayInstance identity and state remain distinct from reusable PatternDefinition and PatternConfiguration identity.
Raw device controls normalize into semantic input commands before runtime state transitions.
Deterministic modules use declared seed/configuration/version inputs and stable transition ordering independent of presentation frame order.
Collision/trigger handling consumes governed semantic references and emits bounded runtime outcomes without creating canonical World/Combat/Action truth.
Runtime and authoring caps fail closed on unbounded entity/spawn/transition configuration.
Unsupported or unknown GPR-01 registry bindings remain unresolved/unsupported rather than receiving generic fallback semantics.
boundaries: GPR-01 remains executable registry/import authority seam and is not duplicated.
MRCS remains reusable definition authority and MAL-01..10 remain frozen.
Action/Event, Character, World/Scene, Combat, Inventory/Asset and other canonical owners retain mutation truth.
Presentation frame timing/order cannot become semantic state order.
GPR-05+ owner-domain operation routing, specialist modules, delivery modes, multiplayer/replay and final golden proof remain unauthorized.
MRCS and OARC lane state remain independent.
next_action: GPR-03 is completed_verified. GPR-05 — Owner-Domain Gameplay Operation, Objective & Route Runtime — is selected_not_started and requires a later GPR-specific owner Continue for governed start.
